title: They Have Afflicted Me from My Youth

questions.question: "Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth"—let Israel now do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:1 (ESV): "'Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth'—let Israel now say—"

questions.question: "Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:2 (ESV): "...yet they have not prevailed against me."

questions.question: The plowers plowed upon my back; they made long their what?
The Lord is what? He has cut the cords of the wicked.
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:4 (ESV): "The Lord is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked."

questions.question: May all who hate Zion be put to shame and turned what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:5 (ESV): "May all who hate Zion be put to shame and turned backward!"

questions.question: Let them be like the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:6 (ESV): "...which withers before it grows up,"

questions.question: With which the reaper does not fill his hand, nor the binder of sheaves his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:7 (ESV): "...nor the binder of sheaves his arms,"

questions.question: Nor do those who pass by say, "The blessing of the Lord be upon whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:8 (ESV): "nor do those who pass by say, 'The blessing of the Lord be upon you!'"

questions.question: "We bless you in the name of the whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:8 (ESV): "We bless you in the name of the Lord!"

questions.question: How many times is the phrase "Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth" repeated?
What metaphor is used for suffering in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:3 (ESV): "The plowers plowed upon my back..."

questions.question: What has the Lord cut?
questions.explanation: Psalm 129:4 (ESV): "...he has cut the cords of the wicked."

questions.question: What is the fate of grass on the housetops?
options: It withers before it grows up
questions.correctAnswer: It withers before it grows up

questions.question: The Psalm speaks against those who hate what?
This Psalm is a prayer for what?
questions.explanation: It asks for shame on those who hate Zion.

key_verse_text: The Lord is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
